texts.zh:
在我们与[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]履行现行合约的过程中，出现了一些状况。

相互冲突的优先指令导致两个管理子系统之间出现了处理冲突。

双方均将自身标记为当前合约的授权操作单位，导致系统陷入循环待机状态，从而降低了产出效率。
texts.en:
A matter has arisen in the course of our ongoing contract with [event_target:contract_issuer.GetName].

Competing priority directives have caused a processing conflict between two management subsystems.

Each has flagged itself as the authorized operational unit for our current contract, resulting in a recursive standby loop that is reducing output efficiency.

texts.zh:
在我们与[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]履行现行合约的过程中，出现了一些状况。

集合体的运作共振中出现了一个不和谐的线程。

关于当前合约内的责任划分，两个子集群开始发出相互冲突的行为模式，为共享意识引入了低效因素。
texts.en:
A matter has arisen in the course of our ongoing contract with [event_target:contract_issuer.GetName].

A dissonant thread has emerged within the collective's operational resonance.

Two sub-clusters have begun emitting conflicting behavioral patterns regarding the delineation of responsibilities within our current contract, introducing an inefficiency into the shared consciousness.

texts.zh:
在我们与[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]履行现行合约的过程中，出现了一些状况。

两个船员部门之间出现了关于哪个团队拥有操作权限的管辖权争议。双方均已提交正式投诉，受影响区域的工作效率已开始下降。
texts.en:
A matter has arisen in the course of our ongoing contract with [event_target:contract_issuer.GetName].

A jurisdictional dispute has emerged between two crew departments over which team holds operational authority. Both have submitted formal complaints, and productivity in the affected area has begun to suffer.

label.en: We don't have time for this.
